item.title: Saturday Morning, Nov 28
item.description:
The Saturday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 28, 2026: Branchburg, New Jersey weather with the full seven-day forecast; Black Friday online spending tops projections as the Macy's parade finally steps off, and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin denies a report that he regrets leaving the Senate; Russia and Ukraine trade massive drone barrages as Kyiv waits on a Black Sea truce, plus Taiwan's local elections and a deadly blast near an Afghan school; Norway's wealth fund will again vote against Elon Musk's pay package and a top Starlink executive departs; Anthropic answers claims that Claude sabotages users' work; experts warn AI labs may be sitting on cryptography breakthroughs, plus a pCloud password manager breach and a twelve-year-old Linux flaw; your X feed; power restoration, I-287 lane closures and Saturday happenings in Somerset County; and a Jack Russell terrier who saved her owner's life. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
